messages.help.levels.body_v002: Click a research card meter or level number to edit its current level in place. Every research level on Player Settings is a directly editable number. Changes made in either view remain pending and stay synchronized until you confirm all of them with Save player settings. Clear level settings resets every research level to zero and immediately updates both the list and the tree.
messages.help.player.body_v002: Set your VIP level and Research Speed. Free speed-up time for the selected VIP level is applied automatically. Enter 224.84 when the game displays Research Speed as +224.84%. Save player settings stores these values together with guild helps, owned resources, and current research levels. Import replaces the saved state, while Backup exports the currently saved state.
messages.help.ocr.body_v002: The Lords Mobile PC client area is captured at its native resolution and is not converted to a fixed frame size. When reading a research tree, the tool first requires at least one research label from the category currently selected in the tool; only then can layout complete unread neighboring cards. Shape and position alone never apply levels to another category. On OCR Input, choose a destination such as Research Speed in the Destination column, verify the value, and apply it. Apply all mapped values processes only rows with a destination. Research candidates remain pending until you use Save player settings. The tool attempts to restore a minimized exclusive-full-screen game for capture, although protected rendering may still prevent capture. It never attaches to, scans, or reads game-process memory.

messages.help.paid.title: Speed-up value of packs
messages.help.paid.body: The Packs tab reads the displayed pack with OCR and calculates total time and time per diamond for general, research, and training speed-ups. When included and bonus gems are present, it also shows total gems and gems per diamond. You can correct every recognized item, quantity, price, and gem value manually. Percentage speed boosts are excluded because they cannot be converted to a fixed duration.

messages.help.title: RLM Research Planner Help
messages.help.introduction: Use this tool to maintain current research levels and review the prerequisites, time, and resources still needed for a target research.
messages.help.tree.title: Using the research tree
messages.help.tree.body: Choose a research category on the left. Drag inside the tree to pan and use Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom. Double-click a research card to open a plan for that target.
messages.help.levels.title: Setting current levels
messages.help.levels.body: Click a card meter to open a slider. Click its level number to open a numeric input that does not repeat the maximum. Release the slider, press Enter, or click outside the card to apply the level. Use Save level settings on the Player Settings tab to keep your changes. Capture game screen and apply levels reads the currently displayed game research tree with OCR.
messages.help.plan.title: Research plans
messages.help.plan.body: For the research double-clicked in the tree and its target level, the plan traces and displays only unmet prerequisites. The list shows game-format time, each resource, required buildings, power, and totals.
messages.help.player.title: Player settings
messages.help.player.body: VIP level, Research Speed, guild helps, and owned resources are applied to plans. Free speed-up time for the selected VIP level is deducted from every research duration automatically.
messages.help.ocr.title: OCR and safety
messages.help.ocr.body: By default the visible Lords Mobile PC window is captured as an image. The captured frame remains at the game's native resolution, and OCR regions follow proportions within that frame. Game settings from 1024×576 through 1920×1080 and full-screen display are supported. The tool does not attach to the game process or scan or read memory. OCR can make mistakes, so confirm the research name and level before applying a result.
messages.help.data.title: Data and display
messages.help.data.body: The bundled catalog supplies research names, layout, dependencies, effects, time, and resources. Category names follow the in-game names Wonder Battles and Guild Duel. Gear, Advanced Wonder Battles, and Mana Awakening are later categories containing research that requires Academy Lv.25. Guild Duel may be unavailable depending on the game version and event rollout. Unavailable values are displayed as Unknown. Display language and version are available on the Help tab.
messages.help.update.title: Updates
messages.help.update.body: Public builds can check for a new version at startup or with the Check for updates button. The downloaded executable is verified with SHA-256 and replaced after you confirm an app restart. Update checks are disabled in development builds to avoid mixing development and public releases.
